design.decision: Plan the opening lead: cash an [A] before opponents void the suit, or lead low toward a partner's honors.
design.opponent: Revealed when it moves the first lead; opponents lose first-lead tempo.
design.rationale: The simplest lead-control effect; the uncommon lead-choice seed measured -6.6, likely because its per-trick choice is hard to use, while one fixed tempo gain is easy to value.
design.draftText: Your team leads the first trick of a round
design.hooks: A team-scoped rule that moves the first lead to the team's earliest seat clockwise from the dealer's left; if both teams have it, the normal rule applies

history.note: draft-common: merged into cb-first-lead, an identical design from another cluster.
